items.title: Valid Passport
items.description: Your passport must be valid for at least 1 year and have at least two blank pages.

items.title: Admission Letter
items.description: Official letter of admission from a German university.

items.title: Proof of Blocked Account
items.description: Confirmation of opening a blocked account with the minimum required balance.

items.title: Travel Health Insurance
items.description: Travel insurance covering the period until you can get German public/private student insurance.

items.title: Biometric Passport Photos
items.description: Recent passport photos meeting the biometric specifications.

items.title: Letter of Motivation
items.description: Explaining why you want to study this course in Germany.
